reason: The cited evidence (E2, E3) confirms precipitate formation in the baseline alloy, but provides no direct support for the key mechanistic premises that Hf traps vacancies, reduces Cr/V mobility, or suppresses precipitates in this system. The Hf-containing alloy in E3 has a very different composition and was not tested for precipitate suppression, so it does not support the specific claim that 3 at.% Hf will suppress precipitates in W38Ta36Cr15V11.
